findings.summary: Ubuntu was cited by its last-updated date and the Debian tracker by the processing date; the note that every added fact predates the window rests on an undated Debian page.
findings.remediation_applied: fixed: Ubuntu is cited by its publication date 2026-11-18; the Debian clause reads 'as of 2026-11-22'; the run note no longer claims every added fact predates the window (the Debian bookworm fix is undated on the tracker)

findings.summary: Cisco's advisory is titled Arbitrary File Write and does not use 'relative path traversal', which is CISA's term.
findings.remediation_applied: fixed: the body attributes the term to CISA's catalog and the entry summary says arbitrary file write

findings.summary: The summary lists nationality; the canton's communiqué as relayed by Polizeiticker and Inside IT lists civil status.
findings.remediation_applied: fixed: 'civil status' replaces 'nationality' (Polizeiticker's verbatim list names Zivilstand)

findings.summary: CVE-2026-120382, an unauthenticated CVSS 9.8 file read and write flaw in the DSM OAuth API, was withdrawn as out of window while nginx2root now points DSM readers to the same builds.
findings.remediation_applied: declined with reason: the primaries are dated 2026-11-19 and 2026-11-20, the source was swept by the previous fire, no exploitation is reported and the nginx2root entry already carries the DSM builds that contain the fix; kept as the audit's strongest G3 lead

findings.summary: Process narration ('read for the id and the score') and four sentences; the CVE record is not linked.
findings.remediation_applied: fixed: rewritten as three plain provenance sentences; the CVE record is not cited, per the repository rule against citing per-CVE pages

findings.summary: Five ledger rows could not be read because the canton FAQ page returned 403 today.
findings.remediation_applied: declined with reason: the claims are unchanged text that the previous fire read from the page and this run did not edit them; Polizeiticker corroborates the core facts
